notes.title: Price Cut to $3.99!
notes.content: This week Going Nowhere: The Dream received a [b]50% price cut[/b] on Steam from $7.99 to $3.99. If this is a game you've been meaning to buy it just became more affordable!

notes.title: Going Nowhere: The Dream Now Available!
notes.content:
Going Nowhere: The Dream is finally released after over a year of development! We’re all super happy to finally publish our first big independent game and hope you consider supporting the team behind it.

HUGE thanks to everyone who was part of the development process. Without the community encouraging us during development we wouldn’t have gotten this far. If you want to join the community head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/GSw2JTZ]Discord server[/url]! Thank you all and finally, please enjoy the game!

notes.title: Release Date Set Back
notes.content:
Due to a bit of an overlook, the Steam release date of Going Nowhere: The Dream will be pushed back. The release date will tentatively be set to [b][u]the 23rd of November but it will likely take longer[/u][/b]. There will be another announcement when the game goes live so please follow the Steam page!

As an apology [b][u]the one week launch discount will increase to 15%[/u][/b], lowering the launch price of the game to [b][u]$6.80[/u][/b].

Going Nowhere: The Dream will still be available on other distributors on the 20th of November as planned. Check http://www.stephanhaldaman.com/goingnowherethedream.html for more information.
